tension_build.prompt: Dark cinematic survival underscore, 110 BPM, D minor, steady 4/4 pulse throughout. Starts sparse with a low staccato string ostinato and a soft synth pulse, gradually adds toms, taiko and a driving eighth-note bass, building tension continuously to a dense, high-energy climax with punchy percussion accents on the downbeats. Instrumental, no vocals, modern trailer production.

flashback_dark.prompt: Dark brooding cinematic cue, 110 BPM, D minor, slow and melancholic. Low sustained cello drones, muffled felt piano notes, a soft low drum pulse on every beat like a heartbeat, eerie airy textures. Instrumental, no vocals, restrained and quiet energy.

payoff_resolve.prompt: Cinematic payoff cue, 110 BPM, opens with a huge orchestral and percussion downbeat impact on the very first beat, D minor resolving to D major, powerful brass and strings with driving drums, high energy, ending with an abrupt hard stop. Instrumental, no vocals, epic trailer production.
